title: Plugin approval request
description: Planned (plugin approval). What the engine's local pages serve at GET /api/v1/plugins/{approvalId} for a short link. A long link carries the same two texts as format 2 (api/mcp/links/compact-request.schema.json): texts [binding, settings] and, optionally, credentialIds. The page takes nothing else as input. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, The plugin approval page.

approvalId.description: Equal to the binding's approvalId and to the id in the page's path; the page refuses a request where they differ.

binding.description: The binding text exactly as Postgres returned it (binding.schema.json). The passkey signs sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes.

settings.description: The settings text exactly as Postgres returned it (binding.schema.json#/$defs/settings). The page shows it, and offers the approve button, only when sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hex, equals the binding's settingsSha256.

credentialIds.description: The database's active passkey credential ids, base64url without padding, passed as allowCredentials. Not signed; may be absent or empty.
